# Contributing to Akyba

Thanks for wanting to help. Everything you need is in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): how to build and
run Akyba, the checks a change must pass (`pnpm health`), how commits are written, and the design
rules. It's written for people and coding agents alike.

Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/itsjonasarden/akyba/issues/new/choose).
